extraction.Name: Josephine Emery
extraction.Recorded patent: recorded May 1, 1918, but records do not show by whom
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to the State of South Dakota for $1000; conveyed by the Emerys to Adolph Stamer for $17000
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612810 issued; Northeast quarter section 7, and North half section 8, township 97, range 69. Receipt for patent signed by the allottee February 27, 1918. On December 4, 1918, Josephine and James Emery mortgaged the Northeast quarter of section 7 to the State of South Dakota for $1000. On January 17, 1921, the land was conveyed by the Emerys to Adolph Stamer for $17000.
